args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Bump to the
patched version on the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting all versions <2.9.4).

This PR upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to **2.9.4**, the first patched version on the 2.x line, per the advisory. I chose the minimal bump within the 2.x series rather than jumping to 3.1.0 to avoid behavioral changes from the major version upgrade — happy to revisit if we want to plan the 3.x migration separately.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**
